preconditions.description: The length of string s is not greater than 10^6 characters.
The number of queries n is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(xi) <= 10**6 for xi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string xi has a length between 1 and 10^6 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in xi) for xi in queries)
preconditions.description: All characters in each query string xi are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated list of counts for each query string xi.
Each count of cyclical isomorphic substrings is non-negative.
The number of results matches the number of queries n.
